title: Querétaro investigates alleged hacking and leaks at municipal agencies including the SSPM; mayor asks people not to speculate
date_note: The article gives only its publication day, 24 November; it does not say when the alleged hack happened.
org: Secretaría de Seguridad Pública Municipal (SSPM), Querétaro
geo_basis: municipal agency in Querétaro city, as the article states
summary: Plaza de Armas reports that officials are investigating alleged hacking and leaks of information from several municipal agencies, including the SSPM. Mayor Felipe Fernando Macías Olvera (Felifer) said cybersecurity and data-protection protocols were activated and that the SSPM is checking whether the published material is authentic. He asked people not to speculate about the posts circulating on social media.
plain: Querétaro officials are investigating alleged hacking and leaks from several municipal agencies, including the police secretariat. The mayor says the material's authenticity is being checked and asks people not to speculate.
exec: A Mexican city says it is checking whether material posted on social media from its agencies is authentic; the scale is not stated.

validation.note: Only Plaza de Armas Querétaro read; the mayor's remarks are as reported by it. The hack is described as alleged and no other publisher was found.
